RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel may reflect existing senior banking demographics rather than overt discrimination, though unconscious affinity bias is always possible. Furthermore, the successful candidate’s regulatory experience provides a credible, non-discriminatory rationale, as department head roles heavily emphasize supervisory compliance over pure quantitative modelling.

Whether to raise it depends on your objectives. Alleging bias before receiving feedback risks burning industry bridges. First, follow up politely on your requested written explanation. If you do raise the panel’s composition, frame it constructively to HR as an inquiry regarding the bank's diversity guidelines for interview panels, unless you uncover concrete evidence of disparate treatment that warrants consulting an employment lawyer.
